spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact shipped surface: all four PredefinedColorSpace enum values through getContext('2d', { colorSpace }) with the getContextAttributes().colorSpace readback the HTML spec defines, and shows the WebIDL enum TypeError verbatim for rejected values.

interactive.rationale: A run-the-matrix button re-executes real getContext calls, and a radio picker creates a context in the chosen space, draws a gradient plus grey bar, and samples the midpoint pixel live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card promises the enum matrix with verbatim answers including the TypeError, which is exactly what the page renders.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch is first-class: rejected values render the full TypeError text, the draw stage states 'nothing is drawn; there is no simulated stand-in', and the flag banner gives the exact ColorSpacePredefinedLinearSpaces enable steps.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, the HTML spec colour-spaces section, and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts round-trips for both linear values, ImageData construction, cross-space conversion with a numeric bound, the unknown-enum-throws contract, and non-regression of display-p3; verified executing on the /conformance/ route (2 pass / 6 fail on Chromium 141, the correct pre-155 shape).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): desktop 1280 and mobile 360 screenshots read and inspected, ?autorun=1 post-interaction DOM grepped for the matrix verdicts and the exact TypeError strings, zero page console errors over CDP.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts linear-canvas-spaces-supported or the explicit -unsupported-fallback branch on load, plus context-created-and-drawn / context-create-fallback per interaction; no noisy console.error paths.

design_system.rationale: All chrome colours are styles.css variables, buttons override background and color together, focus-visible outlines are explicit, and there is no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native radio inputs in labelled fieldset/legend, table with caption and scoped headers, role=status on the support banner, aria-live on the draw readout, canvas has role=img with a describing paragraph, and 44px control targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured scrollWidth equals innerWidth at 360x740 DPR3; the wide matrix table scrolls inside its own .matrix-wrap container; both class screenshots read and legible.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the success path on a Chrome 155 build
openQuestions.detail: This environment ships Chromium 141, so only the TypeError branch could be exercised natively. When a 155+ (or flag-enabled Canary) browser is available, confirm the matrix shows round-trips for srgb-linear and display-p3-linear and that the drawn midpoint bytes differ per store as the readout claims.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates for visual state changes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements with real labels; surface changing visual state through role=status/aria-live text equivalents.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support banner is role=status, the draw readout is an aria-live output element, and the space picker is native radios inside a fieldset/legend rather than styled divs.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel sliders without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let wide data scroll in its own container and use wrapping flex rows for control groups instead of fixed-width layouts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The enum matrix sits in an overflow-x:auto .matrix-wrap with a min-width table, and the picker is a wrapping flex list; CDP confirmed no page-level horizontal overflow at 360px.

summary: Canonical-surface concept for the v155 canvas linear color spaces. Runs the real enum matrix with getContextAttributes readback, draws into a context in the chosen space, and renders the honest TypeError branch on pre-155 browsers. Verified in headless Chromium 141 via CDP + screenshots at both device classes; the native success path awaits a 155 build.
